title: Pipe Fittings, Valves, and Joints Glossary Configuration
description: Standard technical and field glossary configuration for plumbing pipe fittings, valves, and pipe joints based on vocational plumbing standards (NCERT / Indian Plumbing Skills Council).

categories.name: Pipe Fittings
categories.description: Fixtures and components fixed in the plumbing system to join straight pipes or tube sections, change flow direction, distribute supply, or adapt pipe diameters.

items.name: Pipe Collar
items.function: Used while joining two pipes of the same length, fitted into the end of the pipe.
items.notes: Ensures leak-proof axial alignment between consecutive pipe lengths.

items.name: 90° Elbow (Long Radius / Short Radius)
items.function: Installed at the time of joining two pipes when a 90° change in flow direction is required.

specifications.longRadius: Radius is 1.5 times the pipe diameter (LR Elbow)
specifications.shortRadius: Radius is 1.0 times the pipe diameter (SR Elbow)

items.notes: Reduces friction loss in Long Radius; Short Radius suited for tight wall chases.

items.name: 45° Elbow / Bend
items.function: Used when a gradual 45° directional offset or deflection is required in the pipeline.
items.notes: Prevents turbulence and hydraulic hammer compared to sharp 90-degree turns.

items.name: Reducing Elbow (Reducer Type Elbow)
items.function: Simultaneously changes flow direction by 90° while reducing line size between differing diameters.
items.notes: Eliminates need for separate straight reducer plus standard elbow.

items.name: Equal Tee
items.function: T-shaped fitting with a side outlet at 90° to the run of the pipe; all three ports are of equal diameter.
items.notes: Distributes supply from the main header line to fixture branch lines.

items.name: Reducing Tee
items.function: T-shaped fitting where the branch outlet (or run) has a reduced diameter compared to the main inlet.
items.notes: Maintains mainline hydraulic pressure while branching to small plumbing fixtures.

items.name: Y-T Joint / Single Tee Socket with Cleanout
items.function: Combines a 45° wye entry with a sanitary sweep tee, including removable cleanout access cover.
items.notes: Essential for building drainage and soil waste stacks to permit clearing blockages.

items.name: Double Y-T Joint / Sanitary Cross Tee
items.function: Dual branch junction allowing two opposing side lines to feed into a single vertical drainage stack.
items.notes: Used in back-to-back bathroom drainage layouts.

items.name: Reducer Socket / Concentric Reducer
items.function: Connects two inline pipes of differing diameters in a straight run.
items.notes: Smooth tapered internal transition prevents flow separation and sediment entrapment.

items.name: Hex Nipple / Barrel Nipple
items.function: A short piece of pipe having external threads at both ends, used for short extension or linking two female fittings.
items.notes: Ideal for mounting wall taps, mixers, and angle cocks to concealed wall elbows.

items.name: Three-Piece Union
items.function: Fitting made of three components: nut, male threaded end, and female end. Allows quick disconnection without cutting pipes.
items.notes: Mandatory before and after pumps, water meters, and overhead tanks for easy maintenance.

items.name: Four-Way Cross
items.function: Four-way junction with three outlets and one inlet joining four pipes intersecting at 90°.
items.notes: Subject to thermal stress at center node; ensure adequate pipe bracket support.

items.name: Offset Bend
items.function: Shifts a section of pipeline parallel to another section to bypass structural beams, columns, or wall ledges.
items.notes: Maintains uniform drainage slope while circumventing building obstructions.

items.name: P-Trap with Water Seal
items.function: P-shaped bend holding a minimum 50mm water seal to prevent foul sewer gases and explosive methane from entering living spaces.
items.notes: Fitted directly below wash basins, sinks, and urinals.

items.name: S-Trap with Floor Discharge
items.function: S-shaped water seal trap directing discharge vertically downward through floor slabs into branch drain.
items.notes: Commonly used for floor-mounted European and Indian water closets.

items.name: Bottle Trap (Detachable Sump)
items.function: Compact cylindrical trap with removable bottom cup for intercepting dropped jewelry, hair, and debris.
items.notes: Exposed aesthetic fitting installed beneath designer vanity wash basins.

items.name: Nahani / Multi-Inlet Floor Trap
items.function: Shallow water seal trap with removable stainless steel grating installed flush with bathroom/kitchen floor tiles.
items.notes: Receives wastewater from floor wash, bath shower, and basin waste pipe.

items.name: Flange Gasket (Spiral-Wound / Rubber / Neoprene)
items.function: Ring-shaped mechanical seal clamped between two pipe flanges to prevent leakage under high pressure.
items.notes: Withstands line vibration, pressure surges, and rapid temperature fluctuations.

categories.name: Valves & Flow Controls
categories.description: Mechanical devices manufactured from brass, bronze, cast iron, or gunmetal used to stop, regulate, throttle, or control unidirectional liquid and gas flow in mains and service pipes.

items.name: Sluice Valve (Isolation Valve Class 1 & 2)
items.function: Fitted at the entrance of water-supply mains or tank outlets to isolate sections during maintenance or emergency.

specifications.class1Pressure: Test: Body 20 kg/cm², Seat 10 kg/cm²; Max working: 10 kg/cm²
specifications.class2Pressure: Test: Body 30 kg/cm², Seat 15 kg/cm²; Max working: 15 kg/cm²

materials: Cast Iron (CI) Body with Gunmetal / Bronze Trim
items.notes: Full waterway minimizes friction; clockwise closure handwheel.

items.name: Scour Valve (Blow-off / Drain Valve)
items.function: Fitted at the lowest depression points of a pipeline to drain and scour accumulated silt, mud, and sand into natural drains.
items.notes: Crucial for periodic municipal and campus pipeline cleansing.

items.name: Air Release & Vacuum Relief Valve
items.function: Releases trapped air automatically while filling pipeline with water; allows air entry when draining to prevent vacuum collapse.

specifications.threads: Internally or Externally threaded socket outlet
specifications.washers: Fibre, leather, rubber, or nylon disc washer

items.notes: Mounted at summit peaks of long piping headers to prevent air locks.

items.name: Gate Valve (Solid / Split Wedge / Parallel Slide)
items.function: Used for starting or stopping straight-line fluid flow with minimal restriction; operated fully open or fully closed.
items.notes: Provides bi-directional shutoff with zero straight-line pressure drop.

items.name: Globe Valve (Throttling & Regulating)
items.function: Spherical body valve with movable disc element and stationary ring seat, specifically engineered for throttling and flow volume regulation.
items.notes: Precise multi-turn flow rate adjustments; higher head loss than gate valves.

items.name: Angle Valve (90° Inlet-to-Outlet Control)
items.function: Valve with inlet and outlet ports oriented at 90°, where disc moves perpendicular to seat to control flow to fixtures.
items.notes: Standard point-of-use isolation for geysers, toilet cisterns, health faucets, and basins.

items.name: Check Valve / Non-Return Valve (NRV)
items.function: Automatic one-way check valve operated by line fluid pressure; permits forward flow while instantaneously blocking reverse backflow.
materials: Extruded Brass / Bronze with SS Spring
items.notes: Installed after water pumps to prevent water hammer and protect impeller from back-pressure.

items.name: Ferrule Cock (Corporation Ferrule)
items.function: Non-ferrous screw-down cock tapped directly into municipal underground water mains to link private service pipe connections.
items.notes: Under-pressure tapping capability with integrated shutoff plug.

items.name: Foot Valve with Stainless Steel Strainer
items.function: Non-return check valve with exterior perforated debris strainer installed at the bottom of pump suction lines in open wells and sumps.
materials: Heavy Cast Brass / CI with SS 304 Strainer mesh
items.notes: Maintains liquid column inside suction pipe so pump stays permanently primed.

items.name: Float Valve (Ball Float Valve with Brass Lever)
items.function: Mechanically actuated valve attached to an air-filled float ball; rises with water level to shut off inlet supply when tank/cistern is full.
materials: Brass Valve Body with Heavy Copper/HDPE Float Ball
items.notes: Prevents overflowing in rooftop water storage tanks and toilet flush cisterns.

items.name: Full Bore Quarter-Turn Brass Ball Valve
items.function: Quick 90-degree lever handle rotating a chrome-plated brass sphere with bored orifice for zero-restriction shutoff.
materials: Forged Brass Nickel Plated with PTFE Teflon Seats
items.notes: Modern standard replacement for traditional gate valves in residential plumbing.

categories.name: Pipe Joints & Methods
categories.description: Standard pipe joining techniques, fabrication methods, and required joining materials across plumbing pipelines.

items.name: Threaded Joint (Screwed Joint)
items.function: Pipes joined by screwing male external threads into female internal threads using PTFE tape or thread paste.

specifications.compatiblePipes: GI, PVC, CPVC, Cast Iron, Copper pipes
specifications.toolsRequired: Pipe die set, pipe wrench, thread seal tape

materials: PTFE Teflon tape / Loctite 55 thread seal
items.notes: Removable mechanical joint; do not over-torque to prevent female socket split.

items.name: Butt-Welded Joint
items.function: Pipe ends prepared with beveled edges, abutted together, and fused with electric arc or gas welding.

specifications.applications: Commercial, institutional, and industrial high-pressure steam/water systems
specifications.advantages: Low material cost, maximum tensile and burst strength
specifications.considerations: Requires certified skilled welders and pipe fitters

materials: MS / Carbon Steel / Stainless Steel electrodes
items.notes: 100% leak-proof under thermal and pressure cycles.

items.name: Socket-Welded Joint
items.function: One pipe end inserted into an expanded female socket or fitting, and welded around the circumference.

specifications.advantages: Zero risk of internal weld splatter, highest resistance to leakage
specifications.sizeSuitability: Ideal for joining different pipe diameters

items.notes: Leaves 1.5mm thermal expansion gap before perimeter fillet welding.

items.name: Brazed Joint (High Temperature >840°C)
items.function: Joining copper or copper alloy pipes by melting a filler rod (silver-copper-phosphorus) at temperatures exceeding 840°C.

specifications.meltingPointRule: Melting point of parent pipe must be strictly higher than filler rod
specifications.temperatures: Above 840°C using oxy-acetylene or LPG-air torch
specifications.temperatureResistance: Preferred for moderate to high thermal cycles

materials: Silver brazing alloy rod + Brazing flux paste
items.notes: Used in medical gas pipelines, solar water heater loops, and VRV/AC refrigeration lines.

items.name: Soldered Joint (Sweat Joint <840°C)
items.function: Joining copper capillary fittings with lead-free filler wire melting below 840°C using liquid flux to prevent oxidation.

specifications.fluxUsage: Soldering flux applied to clean copper to facilitate capillary flow
specifications.strength: Lower mechanical strength than brazing; suited for domestic water supply

materials: Tin-Copper lead-free solder wire + Zinc chloride flux
items.notes: Capillary action draws molten solder into joint gap.

items.name: Grooved Mechanical Joint (Victaulic Type)
items.function: Pipes joined by roll-grooving the pipe ends, enclosed with an elastomeric C-shaped rubber gasket and bolted ductile iron housing.

specifications.features: Fast assembly, low labour cost, vibration absorption, easy disassembly
specifications.primaryUse: Fire fighting sprinkler mains, chilled water HVAC risers

items.notes: Permits pipeline expansion and contraction without expansion loops.

items.name: Flanged Joint with High Tensile Bolts
items.function: Bolted joint between mating rim plates welded or screwed to pipe ends, compressed against a resilient rubber or CAF gasket.

specifications.applications: Water pumping stations, filtration plants, boiler houses, header manifolds
specifications.advantages: Zero leakage across rapid temperature swings, easy unbolting for pump overhaul

materials: MS / Forged Carbon Steel Flanges (Table D/E/F) + Grade 8.8 Bolts
items.notes: Tighten bolts in diagonal star sequence to ensure uniform gasket compression.

items.name: Compression Joint (Ferrule Fitting)
items.function: Joins plain-end copper, brass, or MDPE pipes without cutting threads or heating, using a brass olive/compression ring tightened by a cap nut.

specifications.preparation: Zero pipe preparation needed; square cut and deburr only

materials: Brass Compression Body + Brass / Copper Olive Ring
items.notes: Widely used for connecting concealed MDPE water meter lines and basin mixer inlets.

items.name: Solvent Cement Cold Weld Joint (PVC / CPVC)
items.function: Chemical fusion joint where solvent primer and cement dissolve outer pipe skin and inner fitting socket, re-solidifying into a monolithic joint.

specifications.curingTime: Initial set 15 minutes, full pressure test after 24 hours

materials: CPVC Heavy Duty Orange Cement / PVC Clear Cement
items.notes: Apply 90-degree twist during insertion and hold for 30 seconds.
